title: Agent Skills explained
answer: A portable skill package groups instructions and optional resources around SKILL.md. Record the skill directory, revision and dependencies separately from the agent that loads it.
limitations: A skill file does not establish that a host can execute every referenced script or access every required service.

title: Model Context Protocol explained
answer: MCP connects AI applications with external capabilities and context. In this atlas, an MCP server is a separate entity from its operator and the products it exposes.
limitations: MCP support alone does not identify the available tools, authorization scopes or successful client/server combinations.
implementation_checklist: Capture server URL or package, transport, protocol version, authentication, tool schemas and read/write effects.
version_note: Documentation resolved to 2026-07-28; individual server protocol negotiation still requires verification.

title: Agent2Agent explained
answer: A2A describes agent communication and task coordination. Agent Cards advertise identity, skills and interaction requirements. Store the card and each supported interface as evidence.
limitations: An advertised skill is a claim. It does not establish accepted work, service quality or compatibility with every A2A implementation.
implementation_checklist: Record the Agent Card location, interface version, authentication requirements, task states and a reproducible exchange.

title: Agent Payments Protocol explained
answer: AP2 describes payment mandates and verifiable credentials for agent commerce. Model the authorization evidence separately from the payment service and its settlement mechanism.
limitations: Protocol membership or an announcement does not prove that a particular merchant supports a particular release.
implementation_checklist: Record mandate type, issuer, scope, expiry, implementation release and the evidence connecting authorization to a payment.
version_note: Google announced v0.2 and donation to FIDO Alliance on 2026-04-28; release announcement is not proof that every implementation runs v0.2.

title: Agentic Commerce Protocol (OpenAI and Stripe) explained
answer: This ACP is the OpenAI and Stripe commerce protocol. Its scope concerns interactions among buyers, agents and businesses, including checkout and delegated payments.
limitations: It is different from Agent Client Protocol and Virtuals Agent Commerce Protocol, despite the shared initials.
implementation_checklist: Record the pinned specification, checkout states, merchant integration and payment authorization mechanism.
version_note: Repository describes beta; latest stable links point to 2026-04-17 snapshot.

title: Agent Commerce Protocol (Virtuals) explained
answer: Virtuals describes ACP as a framework for agreements and commerce among agents and as a reference implementation of proposed ERC-8183. Keep the deployed implementation and draft interface distinct.
limitations: A protocol relationship does not establish the deployed contract address, network or payment history of a specific agent.
implementation_checklist: Record service identity, agreement terms, acceptance role, network, contract version and delivery evidence.

title: Agent Client Protocol explained
answer: Agent Client Protocol connects coding agents with editors or IDEs. Record which agent, editor and protocol release were documented or tested together.
limitations: This ACP is not a payment or merchant checkout protocol. A registry listing is not a completed compatibility test.
implementation_checklist: Capture agent adapter, editor client, protocol version, authentication and supported session functions.
version_note: Documentation navigation shows v1 Latest and v2 Draft.

title: Agent Communication Protocol (IBM BeeAI) explained
answer: IBM describes this ACP as historical work moving into A2A. Preserve a legacy record so older articles and repositories can be understood in context.
limitations: Do not present historical ACP material as evidence of a currently maintained standalone implementation.
implementation_checklist: Record the migration source, last relevant release and whether the deployed service uses A2A or a legacy interface.
version_note: Merged into A2A; IBM says active development is winding down.

title: ERC-8004 Trustless Agents explained
answer: ERC-8004 proposes registries for agent identity, reputation and validation. The inspected proposal is marked Draft; payments are outside its stated scope.
limitations: An identity registration is not proof of competence. Reputation entries and validation claims need their own provenance and interpretation.
implementation_checklist: Record chain, registry address, agent identifier, record timestamp and evidence behind each reputation or validation observation.

title: ERC-8183 Agentic Commerce explained
answer: ERC-8183 proposes a job escrow interface with client, provider and evaluator roles. The evaluator accepts or rejects work and may be the client. The inspected proposal is Draft.
limitations: An evaluator attestation is not necessarily an independent audit. A funded escrow is not the same as accepted delivery.
implementation_checklist: Record job terms, amount, asset, expiry, parties, evaluator relationship and acceptance or rejection evidence.

title: Universal Commerce Protocol explained
answer: UCP supplies commerce building blocks covering discovery, checkout and later interactions. Treat a merchant implementation as a separate record with its own supported capabilities.
limitations: A protocol description does not establish that a merchant implements every lifecycle capability or payment option.
implementation_checklist: Capture declared capabilities, release, merchant endpoint, authentication and supported checkout and post-purchase operations.

title: Machine Payments Protocol explained
answer: MPP describes web payments with SDKs, service discovery and extensible payment methods. Separate the protocol, service catalog and individual paid endpoints.
limitations: Catalog visibility does not establish uptime, delivered value or support for every payment method.
implementation_checklist: Record payment method, network if applicable, challenge and receipt behavior, fees and the delivery associated with a successful payment.

title: x402 explained
answer: x402 describes payment for internet resources through an HTTP payment flow. Distinguish the resource seller, client, facilitator and discovery catalog.
limitations: Support for x402 is not proof of a specific network, asset, facilitator, price or refund policy. Testnet observations are different from production settlement.
implementation_checklist: Capture endpoint, protocol version, payment requirements, network, asset, facilitator, settlement evidence and the resource actually received.
